info.title: SeniorSocial API
info.summary: White-label city connection and services platform for residents 60+
info.description: Every operational resource is scoped by org_id and every response is scoped to the caller's organisation. Cross-org access returns 404, never 403, so that the existence of another organisation's records is not disclosed. All people in every environment of this API are synthetic.

sessionCookie.name: ss_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session cookie issued by /auth/verify or /auth/demo-code. There is no bearer-token surface in the MVP; a future City IdP arrives as an additional OIDC scheme, never as a replacement.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required retry key scoped to organisation, authenticated actor, operation, and target. Authorization is checked before replay. The server atomically claims concurrent requests and preserves the original successful status and body for same-key, same-content retries without repeating mutations; reuse with different canonical validated content returns 409. Retention must cover documented client retry windows and must not silently expire within them.

Forbidden.description: authenticated but not permitted - consent scope or role check failed server-side

NotFound.description: not found in the caller's organisation - also returned for cross-org access

Conflict.description: the request conflicts with current state, an expected version, or prior idempotency-key content

AiDisabled.description: this AI feature is switched off - the human route is in the problem detail

human_route.description: What the person can do instead - present on AiDisabled

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. Never leaks another organisation's data.

total_known.description: false when the count is an estimate - never present a guess as a count

acting_for.description: set when a caregiver is acting under consent

version.description: Current optimistic-concurrency version returned to admin clients

expected_version.description: Must match the current User.version; stale writes return 409

channels.description: per notice-purpose channel choice - a required task notice is independent of unrelated opt-ins

no_outbound.description: when true no outbound job is created at all

shared_device.description: suppresses sender and preview detail on shared phones

eligibility_note.description: descriptive only - never an eligibility determination

citations.description: directory record ids - an answer with no citation must say it does not know

time_zone.description: IANA time zone used to preserve the scheduled wall-clock time
IANA time zone; omitted input uses the server-owned organisation zone
IANA time zone preserved with the proposed instant

after_hours.description: true means no callback time is promised

decided_by.description: always a human - an AI flag alone never hides content

read_back_confirmed.description: the resident heard the list read back and confirmed it - required to grant

answers.description: optional fields stay optional - a partly filled form still saves

intent.description: omitted preserves legacy submit behavior; save_draft never routes

answers.description: when present, replaces the complete saved answers object

intent.description: submit requires disclaimer_acknowledged true in the same request; omitted saves only

purpose.description: task notices are independent of marketing and AI opt-ins

source_version.description: printed on the page - a superseded print is never claimed to be recalled

as_of.description: Data cutoff represented by every tile in this response

source_version.description: Reproducible aggregate snapshot or revision identifier

Report_.description: named report - trailing underscore avoids a collision with the forum Report schema

scope.description: explicit - an export always states what it did and did not include

AggregateExportFilters.description: Aggregate filters use a UTC [from,to) interval. Runtime rejects unknown channels and invalid or reversed ranges with 422.

AggregateExportRequest.description: Aggregate report export request. Authorization determines visibility; this request never implies publication.

ExportJob.description: Individual jobs carry scope. Ready aggregate jobs instead carry report_name, format, normalized filters, snapshot provenance, completeness, row_count and exact-artifact content_digest.

source_version.description: approval is bound to this - a source change invalidates it

critical.description: critical copy may not publish from a machine draft
